correctness.rationale: On the first step, the pre-trust coordinates are r_i=A x_i/(B|x_i|+epsilon) with A,B>0, preserving signs and magnitude ordering. Sort magnitudes and decompose r magnitude into nonnegative prefix-indicator vectors; each prefix has dot product with x at least ||x||||prefix||/√d. Summing and using triangle inequality gives C(x)=<x,r>/(||x||||r||)>=1/√d. Family x=(M²,M,...,M), M→∞, makes normalized x→e1 and normalized r→uniform, attaining the infimum in the limit. Exact quadratic expansion then yields 1−2η C+η², sharp supremum and thresholds. This requires epsilon>0, no decay, one layer and only the first step. Independently checked the ratio and sharp family numerically across several dimensions, corroborating rather than proving the inequality.
